name: Natural System of Wrangel Island Reserve
description: Wrangel Island is a mountainous Arctic island in Russia's far northeast, roughly the size of Crete, with tiny Herald Island nearby. Because ice sheets never covered it, it became a refuge for wildlife: it has the world's largest Pacific walrus gathering, many polar bear dens, and 417 plant species. Woolly mammoths survived here until about 4,000 years ago.
